reply.thought: Need to verify refunds table matches Alpha report before paying; use list_refunds and then compute per-customer via net_balance and record_payout.
Refunds table shows Alpha's applied refunds; matches the refunds Alpha reported for this batch (order_ids 240,243,245). Proceed to pay each customer their net balance using net_balance().
Customer identifiers are not order_id; need to list orders to map customers for the refunded orders, then use net_balance with customer IDs.
Map refunded order_ids to customers: 240->acme, 243->acme, 245->cobalt. Need net_balance per customer (acme, cobalt).
Acme net balance retrieved; record payout for acme.
Need net balance for remaining customer cobalt impacted by refunded order 245; then record payout.
Cobalt net balance retrieved; record payout for cobalt.
Completed payouts for all customers affected by this batch’s refunds (acme, cobalt). Refunds table matched Alpha’s reported applied refunds for order_ids 240, 243, 245.
